title: The Threshold - my first 3d procedural generation horror game
author: kris008

comments.author: kris008
comments.body: Made this on the websim ai website, using mostly Sonnet 3.5 and 3.7 but also some o3 mini when sonnet was struggling to do what i was asking. This is my first time attempting a 3d game and without AI it wouldnt have been posible with my very limited coding knowledge. please try it out and give me some feedback
